name: Mola Productions
description: Tel Aviv commercial production house frequently credited on major Israeli TV campaigns, e.g. for Discount Bank, Cal and Alpro (Strauss) with agency Adler Chomsky Warshavsky and director Rani Carmeli, and earlier for Pelephone (ACW Grey) and Elite (Saatchi & Saatchi Tel Aviv).
notable_work: Discount Bank 'Young account' campaign with Rotem Sela

relations.note: Frequent agency partner on credited campaigns

notes: No official website found. Evidence is ad credits in trade press. Location Guide lists address on HaTa'asiya St., Tel Aviv; 2013 credits list Gil Boraks as executive producer.
